WOFF2 re-encoding (fontTools). Three glyphs moved vertically only, to the hyphen centre: periodcentered +180 units (it sat near the baseline and read as a full stop), endash and emdash +102 units. No shapes, widths or other glyphs changed.

files.derivation: Subset to arrows U+2190-2199, U+21A9-21AA, play/back triangles U+25B6-25B7/U+25C0-25C1, U+2026, U+2212, U+00B2-00B3 and U+00D7 (U+2715 mapped to it). Added geometric pause bars (U+2161), squared plus (U+229E) and check mark (U+2713) drawn at Geist stem weight. Renamed per OFL Reserved Font Name rules.
